name: io.github.WagoAlex/wago-plc-mcp-server
title: WAGO PLC
description: Read and monitor WAGO PLC parameters over the WDA REST API. Read-only unless writes are allowed.

environmentVariables.name: TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: MCP transport. Fixed to stdio for this package.

environmentVariables.name: WAGO_PLC_HOSTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated IPs of the WAGO PLCs, reachable from this machine

environmentVariables.name: DEFAULT_PLC_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: WBM password, same on all listed PLCs

environmentVariables.name: WAGO_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: WDA request timeout. CC100 needs 45 or more, other controllers work with 15

environmentVariables.name: WAGO_ALLOW_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: true lets the agent change parameters, run methods and upload files. Anything else keeps every PLC read-only

environmentVariables.name: AUDIT_LOG_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Optional path for the tamper-evident audit log of writes and refusals

runtimeArguments.name: --network
runtimeArguments.description: PLC subnets are routed via the host network
